findings.finding: Q3 2026 will carry an unrealised FX loss on USD lease liabilities: NBP USD/PLN rose from 3.7708 (2026-06-30) to 3.8449 (2026-09-30), +1.97%; scaling the Q1 2026 loss (-71m PLN on a +3.86% move, 3.6016 -> 3.7408) gives roughly -35m PLN, against ~-7m in Q3 2025 (3.6164 -> 3.6315), so net profit can fall y/y even with flat operations.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 net profit fell 82% y/y largely on non-cash items yet beat PAP consensus (28.2 vs 16.9m) and the stock fell 2.5% next day; Q1 2026's -71m FX loss produced a -1.5% day -- the market reads through it to EBITDA.

findings.finding: Fuel squeezed margins into the peak quarter: Enter Air's Q2 2026 EBITDA fell 5.1% y/y on revenue +26.1% (margin ~23% -> 17.3%) with management saying jet fuel rose sharply and hedges only limited the hit, and Jet2's half to September 2026 (the same summer, same leisure-charter model) showed pre-tax profit down ~18-19% on revenue +5% under Hormuz-driven fuel costs.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EBITDA surprise moved ENT: Q3 2025 EBITDA +26.8% above consensus -> +5.26% next day; Q2 2026 in line on EBITDA (+1.6%) with y/y margin fall -> -2.52%; Q1 2026 EBITDA miss (40.2 vs 43.3) -> -1.48%.
findings.original_quote: Enter Air miał w II kw. 172,4 mln zł EBITDA, wobec 169,8 mln zł konsensusu -- 'Enter Air had 172.4m PLN EBITDA in Q2 against a 169.8m consensus' (EBITDA -5.1% y/y, revenue +26.1% y/y per the same table)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: analysts saw Q2 and Jet2 (2026-11-18). What may not be is that Q3 burns the most fuel of the year at post-spike prices while the USD contract rates were agreed 'w innym otoczeniu kosztowym' (in a different cost environment); if priced, consensus Q3 EBITDA margin would sit well under 30.9%. Offsetting: ENT has beaten PAP EBIT consensus in Q3 2025 and Q2 2026, so the bar may already be low -- hence the small size and wide range.
